fields.details: NavPrana Buffalo A2 Bilona Ghee is a premium, hand-churned superfood crafted from the A2 milk of native buffaloes using the traditional Vedic Bilona method. Slow-cooked over firewood to achieve a rich, granular texture and pure white clarity, it offers a nutrient-dense, chemical-free way to support digestion and immunity.
fields.description: Experience the Art of Slow. NavPrana Buffalo A2 Bilona Ghee is not just an ingredient; it is a bottle of ancient wellness. Sourced from the purest A2 milk of native breed buffaloes, our ghee is crafted using the traditional Bilona method. We follow a patient, multi-step process: hand-milking, slow-boiling milk over firewood, setting fresh curd in clay pots, and hand-churning the curd to extract creamy makkhan.

fields.question: What is Buffalo Ghee?
fields.answer: Buffalo ghee is clarified butter made from pure buffalo milk. It has a rich aroma, thicker texture, and higher fat content compared to cow ghee, making it ideal for strength, stamina, and long-lasting energy.

fields.question: What is the Bilona method of making ghee?
fields.answer:
The Bilona method is a traditional Ayurvedic process where:

Milk is converted into curd

Curd is hand-churned to extract butter

Butter is slowly heated to make ghee

NavPrana Organic follows this ancient method to preserve nutrition and authenticity.

fields.question: Is NavPrana Organic Buffalo Ghee 100% pure?
fields.answer:
Yes. NavPrana Organic Buffalo Ghee is 100% pure, free from:

Chemicals

Preservatives

Artificial flavors

Added colors

Only pure buffalo milk and traditional processing are used.

fields.question: What are the health benefits of Buffalo Ghee?
fields.answer:
Buffalo ghee is known to:

Improve digestion

Support joint strength

Provide sustained energy

Help in weight management (when consumed moderately)

Nourish the nervous system

It is especially beneficial for people with physically active lifestyles.

fields.question: Is Buffalo Ghee better than Cow Ghee?
fields.answer:
Both have benefits.

Buffalo Ghee: Heavier, cooling, strength-building

Cow Ghee: Lighter, easier to digest

Buffalo ghee is recommended for people who need more energy, muscle strength, and endurance.

fields.question: Can I use Buffalo Ghee for daily cooking?
fields.answer:
Yes. Buffalo ghee has a high smoke point, making it perfect for:

Indian cooking

Frying & sautéing

Rotis, dal, rice

Sweets & desserts

It remains stable at high temperatures.

fields.question: Is NavPrana Buffalo Ghee suitable for kids and elders?
fields.answer:
Yes, when consumed in recommended quantities, it is suitable for:

Children (for growth & immunity)

Adults (for energy & digestion)

Elders (for joint lubrication & strength)

fields.question: How should Buffalo Ghee be stored?
fields.answer:
Store in a cool, dry place

No refrigeration required

Always use a clean, dry spoon

Proper storage maintains freshness and aroma.

fields.question: Does NavPrana Buffalo Ghee contain lactose?
fields.answer: Bilona ghee contains negligible lactose, making it generally safe for lactose-sensitive individuals. However, results may vary person to person.

fields.question: Is NavPrana Buffalo Ghee organic?
fields.answer: We follow traditional, natural, and chemical-free practices, focusing on purity and authenticity aligned with organic principles.

fields.question: Why choose NavPrana Organic?
fields.answer:
Because we believe:

Food should be pure

Processes should be traditional

Health should be natural

NavPrana stands for New Life Energy through real food.
